note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md for Quran 2:243-260 (2026-11-26): 18 pictures from 36 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. The Prophet Muhammad is never shown in any way, nor anyone standing in for him; God and the angels are not pictured; no religious symbols of any tradition; nothing violent. Tried and not chosen: A long line of people with bundles walks away from a hill town at dusk, the town behind them empty. A single coin dropped into a jar and the jar overflowing with coins. A hall full of people raising hands in a loud pledge, then nearly empty chairs with just a few left. A tall plain farmer stands apart in work clothes while a group of rich men in suits look him up and down. An old plain wooden chest rests closed in a shaft of light in a quiet empty hall. A hand scoops one handful of river water while around him others drink deeply. A man stands steady in a flowing stream bracing against the current. A small smooth stone lies in a child's open hand against a wall of dark storm cloud. A long staircase up a hillside with people at different heights. An empty market square at dusk with every stall shuttered and the scales left idle. A single steady lit window in a sleeping town at three in the morning. A great mountain range under huge clouds, stretching to the horizon in every direction. A climber's hand grips a solid rock handhold above a long drop. Two people pass each other at a tunnel mouth, one coming out into the light and one going in toward the dark. A man stares at the sunrise in the east and then turns toward the west horizon and finds nothing. A ruined village in the dusk with a single traveler standing at its edge looking at the fallen roofs. An old tree fills a ruined house to its roof beside a loaf of bread that is still fresh on a stone. Four mountain peaks each with a single bird perched on top at sunrise.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Thousands leave their homes for fear of death and God gives them life; lend God a good loan and he multiplies it many times over.
ideas: A long line of people with bundles walking away from a hill town at dusk
A seed in an open palm with a golden wheat field behind it
A single coin in a jar and the jar overflowing

sections.meaning: They ask for a king and then, when fighting is prescribed, turn away except a few; God raises Saul, strong in knowledge and body, though he has no wealth; the sign of his kingdom is the Chest with calm in it.
ideas: A crowd turning away toward the exits while a few stay at the front
A tall plain farmer stands apart while rich men in suits look down at him
An old plain wooden chest resting in a shaft of light in a quiet hall

sections.meaning: Saul tests them with a river: whoever drinks is not with him except a handful scooped by hand; a small company overcomes a large one by God's permission; they ask for patience and firm feet; David, and God repelling some by means of others.
ideas: Hikers kneeling to gulp from a river while one scoops a single handful
Boots planted firmly on a rock in a rushing river
A small stone in a child's hand against a wall of dark storm cloud
A slingshot in a boy's hand in front of a huge building

sections.meaning: Some messengers are raised in degrees above others; spend before a day when there is no selling, no friendship and no intercession.
ideas: A terraced mountainside with travelers on different levels all climbing
An empty market at dusk with every stall shuttered

sections.meaning: God, the Living, the Ever-Standing: neither drowsiness nor sleep takes hold of him; his seat takes in the heavens and the earth, and watching over them does not tire him.
ideas: Star trails over a sleeping village with one window lit all night
A steady lit window in a sleeping town at three in the morning
A vast panorama of land and clouds from a high peak

sections.meaning: There is no compulsion in religion; the right course is clear from the wrong; the firmest handhold does not break; God brings those who believe out of darkness into the light; the one who argued with Abraham was dumbfounded.
ideas: A climber's hand on a solid rock handhold above a drop
A person walks out of a dark tunnel into bright daylight
Two people pass each other at a tunnel mouth, one going in and one coming out
A man facing the west at sunrise with the sun behind him, dumbfounded

sections.meaning: The one who passed a ruined town and was caused to die a hundred years and raised up, his food and drink unspoiled; Abraham's request to see how the dead are given life, answered with four birds that come in haste.
ideas: A ruined hill town with fallen-in roofs and a traveler with a donkey and a loaf
A man waking under a huge tree grown through the ruins, a fresh loaf and a jug beside him
Four birds flying in from four directions to an outstretched hand on a hilltop at sunrise
Four mountain peaks each with a bird perched on top

scenes.principle: Have you not seen those who went out of their homes in their thousands, for fear of death? So God said to them, "Die." Then he gave them life. God is bountiful to people, but most people do not give thanks.
scenes.shows: A crowd streams out through a town gate onto an open road at evening, looking back.
scenes.prompt: A crowd of ordinary people of today in plain clothes streaming out of a town through an old gate onto an open road at evening, some looking back over their shoulders. The crowd and the gate are in the upper two thirds of the picture. No church, no bell tower, no steeple and no tower of any kind anywhere in the picture: only plain low houses with flat or tiled roofs. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Who is it that will lend God a good loan, so that he may multiply it for him many times over? And God withholds and gives amply, and to him you will be returned.

scenes.prompt: A single grain of wheat lying in an open palm held in the foreground with a wide field of golden wheat stretching to the horizon behind, glowing in late sun. The palm and the field are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

The few and the crowd are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

The hikers are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when they came out against Goliath and his forces, they said, "Our Lord, pour patience over us, make our feet firm, and aid us against the disbelieving people."

scenes.prompt: A pair of sturdy boots planted firmly on a large flat rock in the middle of a rushing river, the water breaking white around them, a steady stance, bright light. The boots and the rushing water are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: So they defeated them by God's permission, and David killed Goliath, and God gave him the kingdom and wisdom and taught him some of what he wills.

scenes.principle: Those messengers, we set some of them above others. Among them are some to whom God spoke, and he raised some of them in degrees. And we gave Jesus son of Mary the clear proofs and strengthened him with the Holy Spirit.

The mountain and the groups are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: You who believe, spend from what we have provided for you before a day comes in which there is no selling, no friendship and no intercession. And the disbelievers are the wrongdoers.

No church, no bell tower, no steeple and no tower of any kind anywhere in the picture: only plain low houses with flat or tiled roofs. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: There is no compulsion in religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong course. So whoever disbelieves in false gods and believes in God has grasped the firmest handhold, which does not break. And God is hearing, knowing.

scenes.principle: God is the ally of those who believe; he brings them out of the darkness into the light. And those who disbelieve, their allies are false gods; they bring them out of the light into the darkness.
